mechanism: ACE inhibitors may potentiate the hypotensive effects of levodopa and increase risk of orthostatic hypotension; carbidopa does not significantly interact but levodopa's sympathomimetic effects may be modulated by lisinopril's vasodilation.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, assess for dizziness or syncope, and consider dose adjustment of either agent if hypotensive symptoms develop; patient education on position changes recommended.
